overview_description.description: OpenPipe is an artificial intelligence platform that empowers software developers to construct datasets and refine prompts using a cost-effective model. The platform works by automatically capturing existing prompts and completions and then using them to fine-tune a drop-in replacement.

about_short_description.short_description: OpenPipe is an AI platform that enables software developers to build datasets and fine-tune prompts with a more affordable model.

product.name: Capture Data
product.description: Automatically records LLM requests and responses for dataset creation.

product.name: Train Models
product.description: Enables training of state-of-the-art models on user data with two clicks.

product.name: Automatic deployment
product.description: Serves trained models on managed endpoints scalable to millions of requests.

product.name: Evaluate & Compare
product.description: Facilitates performance evaluation of models using LLM-as-judge evaluations.

product.name: Fine-tuned Mistral models
product.description: Offers models fine-tuned on the Mistral platform for improved performance over GPT-4 at lower costs.

product.name: Flexible Plans
product.description: Provides tiered pricing plans, including per-token pricing and custom plans for larger scale use.
